description: Intent i010 (s03, and-presence-guard) complete. Two high-confidence findings, both the seed's exact mechanism in the same file but distinct unpatched functions (the patched seed function itself was excluded): (1) hwsim_new_edge_nl at drivers/net/ieee802154/mac802154_hwsim.c:421-425 — guard 'if (!info->attrs[MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_ID] && !info->attrs[MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_EDGE]) return -EINVAL;' uses && instead of ||, so omitting RADIO_EDGE while sending RADIO_ID passes validation, and line 425 then passes the NULL slot to nla_parse_nested_deprecated, which dereferences it via nla_data()/nla_len() in include/net/netlink.h → NULL-deref oops; policy marks neither attr required and the op uses GENL_DONT_VALIDATE_STRICT; op is GENL_UNS_ADMIN_PERM (unprivileged-user-netns reachable). (2) hwsim_set_edge_lqi at mac802154_hwsim.c:531-535 — identical inverted && guard and identical NULL-slot nested parse at line 535; additionally its second && guard (lines 538-539 over EDGE_ATTR_ENDPOINT_ID/LQI) leaves both nested slots dereferenced at lines 542-543 without individual checks. Negative evidence: a snapshot-wide multiline grep for negated-presence tests joined by && over info->attrs[N]/attrs[N]/tb[N]/nla[N] returned 16 guard groups; all others (nl80211.c:6553 STA_AID/PEER_AID, nl-mac.c:182/259/490/712 at-least-one idioms with per-attribute guarded reads, nft_tproxy.c:200, vxlan.c:1287, xfrm_user.c:198/210, nf_tables_api.c:1282/6919/7538, devlink.c:3522, nfc/netlink.c:805/1070, nl802154.c:99, nl80211.c:147, genetlink.c:1141, rtnetlink.c:2235, lwt_bpf.c:388, addrconf.c:5804) were verified or reasoned to be legitimate at-least-one idioms whose downstream dereferences sit behind per-attribute presence tests. Limitations: pattern only catches literally spelled &&-joined negated guards (not NULL-comparisons or helper predicates); nine lower-value hits classified safe by reasoning without line-by-line re-verification; unprivileged reachability of both findings additionally requires the mac802154_hwsim module to be loaded/loadable; impact beyond local DoS was not assessed (static evidence only, no live exploit attempted).
